rule.claude: details the plan left open, chosen here: signs = 2 * rng.integers(0, 2, n) - 1 over those entries in column order (one draw of n = 888 integers); the recorded sha256 is of np.stack([indices, signs]) cast to little-endian int64 bytes; the control's carry rows come from a copy of turner_typeb.build_points' rule, first shown to reproduce points.json's carry rows at all 35 fold points; in the reporting rng streams the control's p is 193, the next index after the fold's 0..192
rule.scope_claude: what that floor does and does not bound, measured at registration, recomputed from points.npz and pinned in ROUNDING_SCOPE (a property of the registered tables, not an outcome): on the 888 entries the control touches it moves 1 dcal per entry where the written table's rounding residual theta_r - (t0 + delta_dcal) is at most 0.5 (residual norm 9.202 dcal there, against the control's 29.799), and in total norm the control exceeds the whole residual (9.229 dcal over all 12,607 columns). It is not a superset entry by entry: the written table also rounds 3,636 entries it leaves at Turner 2004, 5 of them by more than 1e-9 dcal (residual norm 0.710, at most 0.5 per entry), and the control does not touch those. So the claim is a floor at least as large as the rounding per entry on the entries the written table changes, and larger in total norm, not everywhere
rule.user: a registered comparator (user's approval): take the entries the Andronescu 2007 point's written table changes, i.e. where theta_r[191] != t0; add +-1 dcal to exactly those entries, with signs drawn from default_rng(SeedSequence([20261012, 42])) and recorded with their sha256; write and fold that table under the same guards, as point 'ctrl'. It moves reference energies by design, so it is not a null point. It is a rounding-noise floor at least as large as the written table's rounding, which is at most +-0.5 dcal per entry

predictions.execution_claude: 6 workers sharded by sequence (i % 6 over fold_rows()), niced by 10, one thread each, no GPU; the driver under setsid; run refuses unless the artifact is tracked and unmodified, the tree is clean outside runs/, this file's sha256 is the registered one and ViennaRNA is the registered version
predictions.exploratory_claude: changes split by baseline MFE degeneracy (gap = 0 vs > 0, the fold's baseline gap; no gap found within 1 kcal/mol counts as > 0); the centroid margin min |p0_ij - 0.5| over the flipped pairs (p0 = baseline float64 pair probabilities); MFE tie flips (dE0 = 0) vs real reorderings (dE0 > 0) at every point including the control
predictions.model: ViennaRNA 2.7.2 (RNA.__version__ asserted in every worker and in preregister, smoke, mini, run and analyse; the version recorded at registration is checked against it), Turner 2004, dangles 0, special_hp 0, 37 C (thermo.vienna_ref.reference_md) with md.compute_bpp = 1 set explicitly and read back. Per sequence and table one compound: mfe(); exp_params_rescale(e_mfe); pf(); then fc.MEA(1.0) and fc.centroid() on that same compound
must_hold_claude: RNA.__version__ == '2.7.2' in every phase and every worker, and the version recorded at registration equals it

this file's sha256 is recorded at registration and equals the running file's in smoke, mini, run and analyse; preregister and analyse(record=True) also require a tree clean outside runs/, and analyse(record=True) requires the run's recorded script sha256

the fold's points.npz and points.json equal fold.points_sha256; the 12 fold shards equal fold.shards_sha256; typeb_common.fold_directions' read-time assertions pass; every point's (kind, name, norm) follows the index rule above; typeb_common.fold_directions is run at both registered test norms, 1 and 16
the copied carry rule reproduces points.json's carry rows at all 35 points; the control's rounding scope recomputes to ROUNDING_SCOPE

smoke: a table written from Turner 2004 itself and loaded changes no MFE, MEA or centroid structure, no MFE energy in dcal and no pair probability (max |dP| = 0) on the 50 smoke sequences, with params_match empty

per table: write_par then loaded(); params_match empty; the 5 carry rows; the Boltzmann carry. Per sequence: the reference-energy identity; the MFE-energy identity; genuine with EXACT_TIE; dE0 >= 0 for every changed MFE
baseline: assert_turner2004_params and assert_turner2004_boltzmann on the first compound; e0 and the MFE's F1 against the reference equal the fold baseline by name

every MEA and centroid structure: a str of length n over '().', balanced, canonical pairs only, j - i - 1 >= 3 for every pair; the centroid's pairs equal {p_ij > 0.5} in the same compound's float64 pair probabilities

the MFE results at the 35 fold points (changed, genuine, f1_ref, leak) equal the fold shards exactly, joined by name: in the worker against the sha-recorded extract shards/fold_ref.json, and in analyse against an extract rebuilt from the fold shards

analyse: every point and decoder, the control included, carries one changed, f1_ref and f1_base value per sequence; with record=True all 11970 sequences are covered and the workers' baseline names are the fold's as a set

analyse on the full set: the MFE tie flips and real reorderings at points 190, 191 and 192 equal 43/524, 44/469 and 35/91, both as pinned in TIE_SPLIT and as read from runs/2026-10-12_turner_typeb_tie_split (status, numbers and sha256 recorded at registration and re-checked); skipped only when the analysis is not on the full set

analyse: _boot_mean's signature is (x, rng, n=1000); the copied amendment-1 bootstrap reproduces the fold's registered difference and ci95 exactly at all 10 grid norms on the fold's genuine arrays (rng SeedSequence([20261012, 5]) in grid order); otherwise nothing is analysed
any failure stops; nothing is repaired
predictions.no_genuine_split_claude: MEA and centroid have no genuine/rounding split: the fold's exact tie split rests on integer MFE energies, while MEA and centroid structures are functions of real-valued pair probabilities. Their changes therefore include rounding-caused ones; that is why T1 is tested against the control. The MFE rounding share at the same points is reported beside them
predictions.points_user: the fold's written tables from fold/points.npz (sha256 checked against the fold artifact), 35: published_own 190-192; null i at 1 kcal/mol (p = 10i+3) and at 16 (10i+7); contrast j at 1 (113+10j) and at 16 (117+10j); i, j = 0..7; plus the Turner 2004 baseline and the rounding control
predictions.question_user: is the Type B headline an artifact of MFE decoding? Refold the fold's written tables and decode every ensemble by MFE, MEA (gamma 1) and centroid
predictions.registered: 2026-10-12, written before any phase of this script ran against runs/2026-10-12_typeb_decoders, and before anything at all was folded on the full 11970 sequences; the full-set T1, T2, per-point and exploratory numbers were unseen. What HAD been seen, in full: (a) the Type B fold's MFE results (runs/2026-10-12_turner_typeb) and its exact tie split (runs/2026-10-12_turner_typeb_tie_split: 43/524, 44/469 and 35/91 tie flips / real reorderings at points 190, 191, 192, now a must-hold here); and (b) MEA and centroid outcomes from five scratch harness runs of this module against a scratch output directory, not runs/: (1) the worker at points 191, 3, 113 and the control on 20 sequences (10 prefix sequences plus 4 per point chosen because their MFE changed in the fold), with their changed counts, dE0 values and centroid margins printed; (2) the smoke, the first 50 sequences at points 191, 3 and 113, plus the three planted failures on 10; (3) the mini, all 35 points and the control on the first 12 sequences, whose dry-run T1 and T2 were printed for MEA and centroid (T1 under MEA at 191: 5 of 12 changed against 0 of 12 at the control; T2 differences at both 1 and 16 kcal/mol); (4) baseline decodes on every 30th sequence and the worker at 191 and the control on the 8 longest sequences; (5) tampered-input negative tests. 12 and 50 sequences decide neither T1 nor T2, but the direction of both statistics on those samples was visible before registration and this is the record of it
predictions.registered_test_T1_scope_claude: the interval resamples sequences only, as the user's amendment specifies. It is conditional on the one registered draw of the control's 888 signs, so sign-draw variability is not in it; a second draw would be a second control, not a wider interval
predictions.registered_test_T1_user: AMENDED by the user before registration (tested against the rounding control). Under MEA, at point 191: the paired per-sequence difference changed_MEA(191) - changed_MEA(ctrl) (values -1, 0, 1 over the 11,970 sequences) has a 95% CI above 0. CI: scripts.turner_typeb._boot_mean (sequence resampling, percentile) with 1000 draws and rng default_rng(SeedSequence([20261012, 40, 1, 191])). Passes iff the lower bound > 0
predictions.registered_test_T2_rng_claude: the plan gives no rng for T2, so this one is chosen: one rng, default_rng(SeedSequence([20261012, 41, 1])) for MEA, consumed at 1 kcal/mol and then at 16, as the fold consumed its single rng in grid order
predictions.registered_test_T2_user: unchanged. Under MEA at 1 AND at 16 kcal/mol: the mean changed-MEA fraction over the 8 null directions minus that over the 8 contrast directions has a 95% CI below 0 at both norms. Method: an exact copy of the fold's amendment-1 bootstrap (turner_typeb.fold_analyse): 2000 draws, each resampling sequences once (shared by both arms) and, independently, each arm's 8 directions with replacement; percentile CI. Passes iff the upper bound < 0 at both norms
predictions.reported_without_prediction_claude: how those three are computed, chosen here: all 35 points and the control; each CI from turner_typeb._boot_mean with 1000 draws and rng default_rng(SeedSequence([20261012, 43, decoder, p])), the three CIs drawn from that one rng in the order changed, dF1, F1-old-new, with p = 193 for the control; paired dF1 = the point's F1 minus the decoder's own Turner 2004 baseline F1, both rounded to 6 dp, so an unchanged structure contributes exactly 0; F1 old-new averaged over the changed sequences only. Beside them for MFE: genuine and rounding-caused counts (at the control every MFE change is genuine by construction, its perturbation being exactly integer). Also reported, NOT tests and labelled would_pass_if_tested rather than passes: T1- and T2-shaped statistics on MFE changed (not genuine) fractions, rng [20261012, 40, 0, 191] and [20261012, 41, 0]; the fold's registered MFE result is on genuine changes
predictions.reported_without_prediction_user: per decoder and point, each with CIs: changed fraction; paired dF1 against references; F1 between old and new structure among changed sequences

predictions.smoke_and_mini_claude: smoke: 2 workers, the first 50 sequences, points [191, 3, 113]; three planted failures on 10 sequences at point 3 that must be caught: the table load skipped (carry row), stale Boltzmann factors (Boltzmann carry), md.compute_bpp = 0 (MEA structure check); then the zero-perturbation control, a table written from Turner 2004 itself, which must change no structure, no MFE energy and no pair probability on those 50 sequences. mini: all points and the control on the first 12 sequences, 2 workers, then analyse without recording.
